full_text:
Bone bolt

Internal ID: BoltBone | Type: Bolt | Source: Black forge | Crafting Materials: Bone fragments x8, Feathers x2

Introduction. Bone bolts are ammunition for crossbows. They are the weakest and only bolt that does not require wood.

Availability. • It is unlocked after building or using a black forge and is also crafted at one.
